Want more Power? Go with a Performance VPS

Cloud VPS Built for what Your Workload Actually Needs

Email servers, blogs, dev environments, and backup jobs need stable RAM, enough storage, reliable bandwidth, and solid uptime. Everyday workloads like these are perfect for Core VPS with proven low-cost infrastructure.

VPS for Web Hosting and CMS

WordPress sites, Joomla installs, Drupal builds, and static-site stacks run reliably on Core VPS. Plans from 8 GB RAM and 100 GB storage handle multiple sites with room to grow, and your server stays stable through traffic peaks with 99.9% uptime.

Private Email and File Server VPS

Self-hosted email stacks like Mailcow, Mail-in-a-Box, and Postfix run well on Core VPS plans with 12 to 24 GB RAM. The same applies to Nextcloud, Seafile, and Samba file servers. Reliable uptime, predictable resources, and full root access.

Backup, Archive, and Storage VPS

Core VPS plans include the option to double capacity through Storage Extension, up to 1.2 TB on the top tier. Backup jobs, off-site archives, and cold-storage workloads benefit most from storage capacity and stable bandwidth.

VPS for Development Environments

Use Core VPS for a feature branch, a staging environment, or a CI/CD runner. Custom images, cloud-init, and SSH keys keep setup simple. Low prices mean dev teams can run more environments in parallel rather than spending on unnecessary hardware.

Core VPS vs. Performance VPS: When to Choose Which

Here's how to compare Core VPS and Performance VPS. Both are built for different use cases. Core VPS optimizes for cost efficiency on lighter workloads. Performance VPS optimizes for sustained performance on compute-focused workloads.

Core VPS

The Best Value VPS on Earth


Ideal for:

  • Standard workloads with predictable resource needs
  • Web apps, small databases, and general-purpose hosting
  • Budget-sensitive projects needing proven hardware
  • Teams who value cost-efficiency over raw speed

Performance VPS

Best Performance VPS for Modern Projects


Ideal for:

  • Compute-focused workloads that push CPU and NVMe
  • Databases, API services, and AI-ready workloads
  • Production environments that need more headroom
  • Projects that demand high-end hardware

Cloud VPS Plans from €4.40/Month

Get a cheap Cloud VPS with the resources you need at a price that works for projects of any size. More headroom than shared hosting with more resources for your money than anywhere else. Here's what makes Cloud VPS the right fit.

Reliable Performance at the Lowest Entry Price

What Makes Core VPS from Contabo the Best-Priced VPS on the Market?

Free Security Features Come Standard

Always-on DDoS protection and a free Firewall come with every Cloud VPS plan. You can easily configure the baseline protection layer you need through your Customer Control Panel.

Reliable Performance for Lighter Workloads

Proven server hardware for web hosting, email servers, and dev environments. Pick the storage tier you need from 100 GB to 600 GB, and double it any time with a Storage Extension.

Unlimited Traffic Included with Every Plan

Every Cloud VPS plan comes with unlimited inbound and outbound data transfer. Port speeds run from 200 Mbit/s up to 1 Gbit/s. Fair usage policies apply.

Auto Backup and Snapshots for Easy Recovery

Auto Backup runs daily off-server backups so an accident doesn't take your data with it. Snapshots allow you to capture your server's state and roll back instantly.

DNS and Domain Management Made Simple

Manage DNS records directly from the Customer Control Panel. Buy a new domain or transfer an existing one and point it at your Cloud VPS in a few clicks.

Flexible Networking and Custom IP Options

Dedicated IPv4 and IPv6 addresses come with every plan. Add more IPs as your project grows and build private networks with unlimited internal traffic for multi-server setups.

Production-Ready Deployment Tools for DevOps Teams

Custom images, cloud-init, SSH keys, and CI/CD pipeline support work with all plans. Solo developers and small teams get the features they actually use, without paying hyperscaler markup.

Fast Provisioning in Minutes for Your VPS

Provision your Cloud VPS in minutes through the Contabo API or the CLI, and scale on demand. In a few clicks from configuration and payment, the server's live before your coffee gets cold.

Intuitive Web UI for Server Management

Manage your Cloud VPS from the Customer Control Panel. Adjust Firewall settings, manage snapshots, configure networking, and upgrade or reinstall your server with ease.

9 Regions, 11 Locations, Global Availability

From the USA to the UK, from Europe to Asia and Australia, choose your ideal VPS hosting location for low latency worldwide.

Core VPS FAQs

FAQs | More information on Core VPS
What hardware and CPU does Core VPS from Contabo use?

Core VPS runs on proven infrastructure across multiple CPU generations, virtualized with KVM. Hardware is selected for workloads like web hosting, CMS, email, and dev environments, where CPU is rarely the bottleneck. RAM and network throughput are what move performance for these workloads, and those specs are generously allocated across the Core VPS lineup.

Who is Core VPS best for?

Core VPS is the best VPS for lighter, everyday workloads: hobbyists, freelancers, and small teams. Common buyers include WordPress and CMS hosts, self-hosted email and file server operators, dev and staging environment users, and small SaaS backends that want affordable VPS hosting with predictable monthly cost. If your workload runs reliably on proven hardware, paying for the latest CPU generation is unnecessary. That's what cost-efficient VPS hosting like Core VPS is for

How does Contabo Cloud VPS pricing compare to other European providers?

Core VPS is priced for value across the European hosting market. Plans start at the lowest entry point in the Contabo VPS lineup and scale to 18 vCores and 96 GB RAM with no hidden fees. Compared with other European cloud providers, Contabo pricing is competitive at every tier, particularly for workloads that don't need the latest CPU generation.

Can I upgrade from Core VPS to a higher tier later?

Yes. When to upgrade to VPS hosting at a higher tier is up to you: scale RAM, vCores, and storage in place from the Customer Control Panel without rebuilding the server. If your workload outgrows the top Core VPS tier, the next step up is the Performance VPS line, offering the latest generations of AMD EPYC CPUs, NVMe storage, and high bandwidth. That migration is a one-time move, not an in-place upgrade. You can easily upgrade at any time via your Customer Control Panel.

What operating systems can I run on my Cloud VPS?

Free OS options for your VPS include Ubuntu, Debian, AlmaLinux, Rocky Linux, CentOS, openSUSE, and FreeBSD as Linux VPS options. Windows VPS is available with Windows Server as a paid Add-On, where the license cost is added to the monthly bill. You can also upload custom ISOs through the Customer Control Panel and install any OS that runs on KVM, including specialized Linux distributions and BSD variants.

Which projects and applications can I use a Cloud VPS for?

A Virtual Private Server like Core VPS handles a wide range of projects: WordPress and other CMS-based VPS hosting setups, self-hosted email servers (Mailcow, Mailu, Postfix), file servers (Nextcloud, Samba), Discord and small game servers, dev and staging environments, VPN endpoints, monitoring stacks, and small SaaS backends. Web hosting VPS workloads are some of the most common projects on Core VPS, but any lightweight project that runs on Linux or Windows Server is suitable.

How do I configure my Cloud VPS after purchase?

Provisioning takes a few minutes after payment clears. You'll get login credentials by email, then access the server through SSH (Linux) or RDP (Windows). The Customer Control Panel handles snapshots, reinstalls, network settings, and Firewall rules. The Contabo API and CLI are Terraform-compatible, which makes Contabo's Cloud VPS a practical fit as the best VPS for developers running infrastructure-as-code workflows. Cloud-init for Linux and cloudbase-init for Windows are also supported for automated first-boot setup.

What payment methods are available?

We accept payments in EUR, USD, and GBP, with different payment methods depending on the currency. Please see the full list here and this helpful video guide for more information.

For all payment methods other than credit card, the first payment after you have submitted an order has to be done manually. Please use the payment information provided after the order process. Once you have access to your Customer Control Panel, you can manage your payment methods, make payments, and set up automated payments conveniently.

Do you offer hosting panels for VPS?

Yes, we offer cPanel and Plesk hosting control panels at additional cost. We also offer Webmin for free. Note that we’re offering Plesk for free for the first month across our Cloud VPS, Cloud VDS, Storage VPS, and Dedicated Server plans.

If you’re not satisfied with Plesk within the first month, then just cancel it before the end of your first month through the Customer Control Panel (you won’t be charged if you cancel it before the first month ends). We also put together this hosting panel comparison guide to help you decide which panel is best for your needs.
